statement_refuted: Nonzero orthogonal longitudinal leakage in both quantitatively transverse B19 banks forces a rank-three physical cross block whose three nonzero singular values are uniformly bounded below.
counterexample_summary: An exact-rank-three Parseval family with spectrum {1,1,-1}, S_J=S_K=(1/2)I_2 and eta_J=eta_K=eps*u has J-K cross singular values exactly {1/2, eps/sqrt(2), eps/sqrt(2)} for every eps>0. Thus both leakages are nonzero while two cross singular values tend to zero as eps tends to zero. The target conjecture is not refuted: a one-zero physical triple has determinant -1/32 and the completed account03/B04 r18 theorem gives density <=3*2^(7/3)<15.12 uniformly in eps.
